assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature priority is 'Normal' (not 'Undefined'). Impact map's 'Field Inheritance' section states: 'Priority: Normal (inherited from TC-9002, will be propagated to all tasks)'. Summary-comment.md states: 'Priority: `Normal` — inherited from TC-9002 and propagated to all created tasks via `additional_fields.priority`.' The additional_fields JSON block shows '"priority": {"name": "Normal"}'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature fixVersions: 'RHTPA 1.6.0' (non-empty). No fixVersion scope config in CLAUDE.md, so defaults to 'both'. Impact map states: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0 (inherited from TC-9002, will be propagated to all tasks — no fixVersion scope restriction configured, defaulting to "both")'. Summary-comment.md states: 'Fix Versions: `RHTPA 1.6.0` — inherited from TC-9002 and propagated to all created tasks via `additional_fields.fixVersions`. No `fixVersion scope` setting is configured in CLAUDE.md Jira Field Defaults, so the default behavior ("both") applies.' Additional_fields JSON shows '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.6.0"}]'.
